name: Animated Colossus

defensiveAbilities.name: Enormous
defensiveAbilities.description: An animated colossus takes up a space of 6 squares by 6 squares (30 feet by 30 feet) and is 100 feet tall.

offensiveAbilities.name: Colossus's Grasp
offensiveAbilities.description:
The colossus can Grab a creature using only one hand.

It can move normally with a creature Grabbed or Restrained in its fist, carrying the creature along. If it has two creatures grabbed in this way, it can't use its fist Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
3d12+11 bludgeoning, DC 36 basic Fortitude save

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trample
offensiveAbilities.description:
Huge or smaller, foot, DC 36 basic Reflex save

See rules...

The monster Strides up to double its Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures of the listed size, Trampling each creature whose space it enters. The monster can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single use of Trample. The monster deals the damage of the listed Strike, but trampled creatures can attempt a basic Reflex save at the listed DC (no damage on a critical success, half damage on a success, double damage on a critical failure).

description:
Animating a 100-foot-tall statue is worth the cost for spellcasters guarding immense dungeons.

Many animated objects have useful functions but become dangers when uncontrolled.
